question: How much will Gold Futures total price returns exceed S&P 500 Futures in these biweekly periods of Q4 2026? (Nov 23 - Dec 4)

calls.reasoning: P0 is the Nov 20 close (GC ~3529 after -4.3%, ES ~7040 after -2.2%); window Nov 23-Dec 4 is ~9.5 sessions incl. Thanksgiving. Reference class: biweekly GC-ES spreads, historically centered near 0 with SD ~4-5pp; current stressed regime (gold -37% from 52w high, Fed-hike bets, strong dollar, broad liquidation) inflates realized spread vol to ~1.5-1.9%/day. Median slightly negative for gold downtrend momentum, offset by rebound potential after a capitulation-like day. Fat tails priced via ~3% escape mass on each side. No matching human market found (Kalshi year-end gold strikes only, not comparable).
calls.reference_class: Historical 10-trading-day GC minus ES percent-return spreads (2025-2026), Yahoo Finance daily closes

calls.reasoning: Reference class: 9-trading-day GC minus ES return spreads. Over the last 3 months this spread has been mostly negative (7 of 8 consecutive two-week windows, mean ~-2pp) because gold is in a steep downtrend (-23% from Aug, -9% since Nov 11) driven by Fed hike pricing (Dec 8-9 meeting, >97% odds of a hike) and margin-call liquidation. Two-week momentum in this spread is weak and gold is oversold, so I shrink the median to about -0.4. Volatility is elevated (gold down 4% intraday Nov 20, ES -2%), so SD is ~4pp with fat tails; small escape masses cover gold continuing to collapse or squeezing sharply. No prediction market prices this spread (Kalshi/Polymarket only have gold-level contracts, which do not match).
calls.reference_class: 9-trading-day GC=F minus ES=F percent return differences, 2025-2026, weighted to the last 3 months

calls.reasoning: Base rate: past-year 10-day GC-ES return spreads (Yahoo daily closes) have mean near 0 and SD ~4pp. Current regime is high vol: gold down ~14% in 2 weeks on Fed-hike bets/strong dollar/margin-call liquidation; ES down ~10% in its worst week since Mar 2020 with VIX >30 after the Anthropic IPO AI selloff. That widens the window distribution to SD ~5pp with fat tails. Slight negative median: equities tend to rebound after VIX spikes while gold's macro headwinds (Dec hike ~95% priced, strong USD) persist, though gold is also oversold. ~3% escape mass each side for a continued gold crash or an equity crash. No matching human market found (Kalshi has only year-end gold and annual S&P-vs-gold contracts, not this window).
